audience: marketing, pricing and operations teams that watch web pages for changes in Visualping

useCases.title: Find pages that changed recently
useCases.text: Find the workspace id, list the monitoring jobs and open one to read its detected changes and AI summaries.

useCases.title: List paused jobs and recent checks
useCases.text: Filter the jobs by status to list the paused ones. List the recent check runs of a workspace, with failed checks if you ask.

useCases.title: Watch a price page every day
useCases.text: Create a job that checks a page on an interval and reports changes. It starts active unless you set active to false.

useCases.title: Pause or resume a monitoring job
useCases.text: Set active to false to pause a job, or to true to resume it. Repeating the same change has no further effect.

useCases.title: Review labels and job counts
useCases.text: List the labels of the organisation, with the number of jobs under each label.
